Chapter 130: Chapter 15 Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, The Thirteenth Disciple

Chapter 130: Chapter 15 Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, The Thirteenth Disciple

Seventh Star Cave.

The mountains shook and swayed.

The most affected were undoubtedly the challengers who were still comprehending the stone statues.

Among the numerous challengers in the Seventh Star Cave, only three or five were Golden Pattern Challengers, and all the rest were Silver Pattern.

As for those three Red Pattern Examiners, they had already passed the test and left the Seventh Star Cave several days ago.

The majority of Golden Pattern Challengers had also left.

“What’s happening?”

...

“Why do I feel like the ground is unstable?”

“An earthquake? Can virtual worlds even have earthquakes?”

…

The challengers looked at each other, puzzled. They were all Third or Fourth Rank Evolvers, not one to lose their balance due to such tremors.

But what place was this?

The Seven Star Cave World, a test world opened by the great Chikun Star Lord.

To ensure the fairness of the challengers’ comprehension of the stone statues, the entire Seventh Star Cave was incredibly stable, with no chance of any unexpected variables.

But now?

“Why do I feel that the statue in front of me is trembling?”

At that moment, a challenger seemed to discover something, staring in disbelief at the stone statue he had been contemplating for half a month.

This statue, nearly three meters tall, was one of the top statues among the many containing Sixth Rank Evolution Paths.

And with the attention of the other challengers.

It was immediately discovered.

Under the trembling of the ground.

Not only the two- to three-meter-tall statues were affected.

Even those over ten meters tall that contained Evolution Paths surpassing Sixth Rank were also affected.

The specific manifestation was.

The originally motionless giant statues of over ten meters.

For example, the huge ‘Rubik’s cube,’ whose six faces slowly rotated, creating waves of spatial ripples.

And that ‘gaping mouth’ statue, which seemed like an abyss within, with an indistinct whirlpool swirling.

Every one of the giant statues containing Evolution Paths surpassing Sixth Rank was releasing its own aura as much as possible, influencing and assimilating its surroundings.

But at this moment.

All the giant statues over ten meters tall were as if dead, the six faces of the huge Rubik’s cube stopped turning, and the eerie breath of the gaping mouth statue had completely subsided, as if it were just an ordinary statue.

“Something special has definitely happened.”

Fang Qing also stopped contemplating the statue in front of him.

What the old man with the white beard had told him about the Seventh Star Cave was very clear.

That was, this Star Cave tested the enlightenment of each Evolver.

“What’s with him?”

Fang Qing observed his surroundings.

He noticed that the challengers sitting beneath the statues all showed puzzled and shocked expressions.

Only in a distant corner, a challenger lying on the ground resting remained unchanged.

While everyone was conversing anxiously,

this challenger was lying on the ground motionless, paying no heed to the continuously trembling ground.

“Golden Pattern…”

Fang Qing had noticed this peculiar Golden Pattern Challenger early on.

Without rushing to comprehend the statues and pass the Seventh Star Cave, he was just lying there resting.

…

Mysterious Space.

Twelve figures experienced a surge of emotions.

Those challengers did not know what the trembling mountains meant, but these figures were different as disciples of the Star Lord, they knew much more than the outside world.

“Has someone passed the final test?”

“Who on earth was it? The difficulty of the final test is so high, even if I were to comprehend it, I might not succeed. How did these Third and Fourth Rank little ones manage it?”

“A momentous event; something my Red Kun Lineage hasn’t encountered in ten thousand years.”

…..

The twelve figures were immensely shaken, precisely because their greater knowledge made them acutely aware of the difficulty of passing the final test.

That was not meant for the normal challengers.

“It’s Lin Yuan.”

“It must be Lin Yuan who has passed the final test.”

The twelve figures glanced over each challenger.

In the end, their gaze stopped on Lin Yuan.

They had no choice.

Compared to the shock, anxiety, and unease of the other challengers,

only Lin Yuan remained unchanged from beginning to end.

Moreover, the twelve figures could feel that the trembling of the entire mountain emanated from Lin Yuan, rapidly spreading in all directions.

“Lin Yuan, wasn’t he just loitering around before?”

“Could it be that he wasn’t just loitering but was secretly comprehending the final test?”

“It must be so. Who would have thought? Who would have thought that Lin Yuan could bring us such a big surprise…”

The twelve figures rapidly exchanged thoughts,

immediately deducing the reason behind Lin Yuan’s previous strange behavior.

As disciples of the Star Lord, the twelve figures knew that besides the 136 stone statues containing Evolution Paths in the Seventh Star Cave,

there was a 137th Evolution Path.

This Evolution Path was not found within the statues but within the mountain itself.

Unfortunately, despite the Seven Star Cave World being opened hundreds of times over ten thousand years, and thousands of Red Pattern Challengers entering the Seventh Star Cave, nobody had even thought of comprehending this Evolution Path.

So much so that the twelve figures had also overlooked this final test, only realizing it after the mountain trembled for a while.

“The final test… Lin Yuan is actually suitable for this Evolution Path. If he continues to develop smoothly, there is a great possibility of surpassing Sixth Rank.”

The nine figures below, looking at Lin Yuan who was lying on the ground, could not help but speak out.

From Sixth Rank to Seventh Rank… is a major bottleneck and shackles.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, among the billions of races, even the very few with special bloodlines and high starting points, powerful beings, cannot easily surpass Sixth Rank.

The Chikun Star Lord’s original form was the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, one of the pinnacle bloodlines in the Cosmic Starry Sky, reaching Sixth Rank Life upon maturity.

Even so, to surpass Sixth Rank, the Chikun Star Lord had spent thousands of years.

This was because the Chikun Star Lord had good aptitude; most Wanderer Kuns couldn’t break through Sixth Rank.
